issues.title: record_shadow_from_proposals() never called in live dispatch path
issues.root_cause: The if args.no_mt5: branch calls record_shadow_from_proposals() for verification mode. The else: branch (live trading) dispatches orders but never persists shadow decisions.
issues.impact: Zero decision records from live trading; feedback loop, brain leaderboard, and retraining trigger operate on empty data.
issues.fix_approach: Add _record_shadow_decisions(proposals, ...) call after signal generation in the live else-branch, before dispatch.

issues.title: Decision record path mismatch between producer and consumer
issues.root_cause: JsonlLedgerStore writes to data/{date_key}/{symbol}.decisions.jsonl but feedback_loop.py reads from data/decisions/{date_key}/{symbol}.decisions.jsonl. The decisions/ subdirectory is missing from producer path.
issues.impact: Even when decision records ARE written, the feedback loop cannot find them.

issues.title: No position_ticket in any journal entry; P&L computation impossible
issues.root_cause: Journal entry written from pre-execution envelope fields. Post-execution position_ticket in detail.order never written back.
issues.impact: All 10 trades unlabeled. label_builder cannot match open/close pairs. Zero training datasets produced.
issues.fix_approach: After receiving order result, update journal entry with position_ticket = detail.get('order') before archiving.

issues.title: OU_Params_V6_Sniper artifact file missing; runs as stub
issues.root_cause: Config references D:\ai\Meta_ppo_v6\arb_params.json which does not exist. Adapter falls back to stub: neutral output.
issues.impact: Wastes voting slot in 3-brain ensemble. Stub neutral vote drags agreement_score down.
issues.fix_approach: Disable OU_Params_V6_Sniper in configs/live.yaml brains.registry_entries until artifact is trained.

issues.title: Schema mismatch: XAUUSD (v9_institutional_40/M5) vs XAUUSDc (v9_institutional/M1)
issues.root_cause: Two different schema names/symbols/timeframes registered. Shadow ensemble queries stale XAUUSD data; live writes XAUUSDc data that nobody reads.
issues.impact: Shadow ensemble runs on April 1-18 data instead of live May 4 features.
issues.fix_approach: Unify to v9_institutional_40/1.0.0 schema. Update feature_update_producer to XAUUSDc/M5. Update shadow ensemble query.

issues.title: Symbol inconsistency across 12+ files
issues.root_cause: Live trading uses XAUUSDc (MT5 broker convention). Shadow, healthcheck, brains, daily_ops use XAUUSD.
issues.impact: Feature queries return empty/stale data. Shadow reports show wrong symbol. Healthcheck probes wrong symbol.
issues.fix_approach: Centralize to XAUUSDc across all subsystems. Add symbol normalization in feature store query layer.

issues.title: RiskEvaluationService never instantiated in live intent loop
issues.root_cause: RiskEvaluationService exists but is never imported or called in live trading path. No risk context (drawdown, exposure) supplied.
issues.impact: Risk policies defined but never enforced. Only cooldown + max_positions protect live trading.
issues.fix_approach: Import RiskEvaluationService, build risk context from MT5 account state, evaluate before dispatch.

issues.title: Zero training datasets built; label_builder cannot match open/close pairs
issues.root_cause: Depends on QO-0003. Without position_tickets, all trades unlabeled. Symbol query also mismatched.
issues.impact: data/training/ contains zero Parquet/NPZ files. Self-evolving loop starved of input.
issues.fix_approach: After QO-0003: fix label_builder ticket matching, fix dataset_builder symbol, generate first dataset.

issues.title: Feature warmer replicates M5 data across all timeframes
issues.root_cause: M5 features copied to M15/M30/H1 slots with comment about approximation. Not real multi-timeframe computation.
issues.impact: M15/M30/H1 features are statistically identical to M5 — provide no additional information to models.
issues.fix_approach: Compute each timeframe independently from corresponding OHLC bars at each resolution.

issues.title: 6+ bare except:pass blocks silently swallow failures
issues.root_cause: Critical operations wrapped in try/except:pass with zero logging. Feature write, brain inference, decision recording failures are invisible.
issues.impact: Operators cannot distinguish 'no data to record' from 'recording crashed'. Debugging requires code inspection.
issues.fix_approach: Replace each except:pass with except Exception as exc: logger.warning(...) using module-level logger.

issues.title: Corrupted entry: MT5 path parsed as alpha_id
issues.impact: Corrupted registry entry. Would cause errors if governance iterates over alphas.
issues.fix_approach: Remove corrupted entry. Fix path-to-alpha_id conversion to use basename sans extension.

issues.title: 2 of 4 baseline subdirectories empty; incomplete coverage
issues.root_cause: neutral_stability/ and risk_boundary/ categories have zero files. Only 4 baseline files total.
issues.impact: Shadow-live comparison cannot detect divergence in neutral stability and risk boundary scenarios.
issues.fix_approach: Run shadow ensemble across full scenario spectrum; commit baselines for all 4 categories.

issues.title: Recap runs before trading activity; misses actual trades
issues.root_cause: Recap at 14:13 local time, trades at 19:19 local time. Reports zero activity on active trading days.
issues.impact: Historical recaps misleadingly show zero activity on days when trading occurred.
issues.fix_approach: Schedule recap after market close or query full 24h window regardless of run time.

issues.title: Hardcoded Path.cwd() references depend on launch directory
issues.root_cause: Multiple Path.cwd() and os.getcwd() calls assume process launched from project root.
issues.impact: Path resolution breaks if launched from different directory (systemd, task scheduler).
issues.fix_approach: Replace Path.cwd() with Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent for PROJECT_ROOT derivation.

issues.title: Garbled Chinese characters in daily recap run_state field
issues.root_cause: Chinese text encoded in non-UTF-8 codec (likely cp936/GBK) written to UTF-8 JSON log.
issues.fix_approach: Add encoding='utf-8' to all file open() calls. Set PYTHONUTF8=1 env var.
